topic: Sensor data filtering for facility analytics
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered a technical issue regarding virtual sessions being incorrectly generated in the analytics for facilities with sensors. Specifically, when sensor data was linked from other facilities, it resulted in an overabundance of virtual sessions layered on top of real ones, making accurate deduction difficult.

It was decided that a fix or guardrail should be implemented to prevent this issue—specifically, ensuring that if a physical sensor is present at a facility, no 'mirroring' (virtual session generation) occurs under any circumstances. [me] confirmed that this fix is possible.
decisions: Implement a technical safeguard to prevent virtual session mirroring when physical sensors are detected at a facility.
action_items: [p1] provided a ClickUp link for the development task related to the sensor data filtering issue.
